method: independent source, contract, controlled-vocabulary, exactness, closure, historical-labeling and no-fallback audit
rationale: A finite approved rumor profile uses the controlled process kind, exact bound carrier-path timing, source/target applicability, a source-bound knowledge effect, deterministic termination and strict separation between factual events and rumor knowledge.
limitations: Approval covers authoring data only; physical DDL binding, importer implementation, PostgreSQL integration, runtime tests and P28 remain developer-owned.
